name: DarkPlaces
description:
DarkPlaces is an advanced, open-source Quake engine source port developed by Forest "LordHavoc" Hale. Renowned for its cutting-edge graphics technology, it introduces real-time dynamic per-pixel lighting, normal mapping, and advanced particle effects to classic Quake.

Features:
- Modern rendering pipeline featuring real-time dynamic shadows, bloom, and gloss maps
- Support for high-resolution replacement textures and 3D character models
- Enhanced networking and multiplayer protocol with improved client prediction
- Extensive console configuration options and video settings
- Compatible with classic Quake, Quake mission packs, and standalone total conversions
